summary: Police arrested seven people in Karnataka for the rape and forced abortion of a woman. The accused allegedly gave the woman abortion pills to terminate her pregnancy.
title: Seven arrested in Karnataka for rape and forced abortion
verification_note: The source confirms the arrest of multiple individuals in Karnataka for a rape offence.

summary: A former member of parliament serving a life sentence for rape was shifted to a general cell in Bengaluru. Prison authorities moved him after finding a mobile phone and a pen drive during a raid.
title: Former MP shifted to general prison cell in Bengaluru
verification_note: The source confirms the rape case and conviction status of the accused in Bengaluru, Karnataka.
